name: robocode-lab-kit.zip
title: Lab PC kit (everything, no admin needed)
about: Python 3.13, Java 21, the Robocode app, sample bots and the starter bot. Extract, then run install.cmd.

name: MyBot-starter.zip
title: Starter bot (MyBot)
about: A working bot to start from. Rename the class, the .py and the .json to your bot's name before you submit.

name: Install-guide.md
title: Install guide (for officers)
about: What the kit installs, how to do it by hand, and fixes for common problems. Opens in Notepad.

name: robocode-tankroyale-gui-1.4.0.jar
title: Robocode Tank Royale app 1.4.0 (just the app)
about: For PCs that already have Java 21+. The kit includes it.

name: sample-bots-Python-1.4.0.zip
title: Python sample bots 1.4.0
about: The official sample bots (SpinBot, Walls, Crazy, ...). The kit includes them.
